name: des_key_literal
comment: Original ROM uint32 value is 0x76; DES copies its first byte only.

name: default_internal_key_codes
comment: 66x3 internal key-code table, not USB usages.

name: application_state
comment: 0 normal, 1 key config read, 2 RGB read, 3 counters read, 4 low-power/wake handling.

name: key_event_count
comment: Number of bytes queued at key_events.

name: scan_record_count
comment: Number of pending seven-byte row records.

name: scan_enabled
comment: Scanning gate, cleared during settings/update transfers.

name: transport_is_wired
comment: 0: external UART module path; nonzero: wired path.

name: wired_protocol
comment: 1 USB, 2 PS/2, from key event dispatch.

name: rgb_active
comment: Selects RGB-dependent acquisition and correction coefficient.

name: key_events
comment: Event bit 7 denotes press; other seven bits are physical key identifier.

name: scan_records
comment: 256x7 byte queue: row index followed by six samples.
